Entangling: state = self._apply_cnot(state, q, target) where target = (q+1) % n_qubits.
Initialize and encode: state[0] = 1.0; state = self.encode_input(state, x[:self.n_inputs]).
Apply layers: for layer in range(self.n_layers): state = self.variational_layer(state, params, layer).
Z expectation: z_operator[i,i] = 1 if first_bit==0 else -1; expectation = np.real(state.conj() @ (z_operator @ state)).
